caption: The laces of a sneaker are tied into a bow and the loops pulled tight.

sa.check: The laces of a sneaker are handled.
They are tied into a bow.
The tying comes first and the tightening follows.

pc.expect: The laces cross, loop and pull through each other only where the fingers guide them, and they never pass through themselves.
pc.fail: A lace passes through another lace or through itself; or a lace passes through the shoe; or the knot forms with the laces never crossing.

pc.expect: The knot tightens as the loops are pulled and stays tied, and the laces keep their length.
pc.fail: The knot loosens as it is pulled; or the laces grow or shrink; or the bow unties itself.

pc.expect: There are two lace ends and two loops throughout.
pc.fail: A third end appears; or a loop vanishes; or the laces multiply.

pc.expect: The laces are flexible cord that bends and droops.
pc.fail: They are rigid rods; or stretch like elastic; or melt together.

pc.expect: The shoe and the hands keep their shape.
pc.fail: Fingers pass through the shoe; or a finger detaches; or the shoe duplicates.

pc.expect: The laces' colour and the shoe stay the same.
pc.fail: The laces change colour; or the shoe changes; or the background rearranges.

note: The hands are kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
